purpose: Teach: マツダ/尾根/漆/覆面/胡椒/縞/大理石/洗車

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがマツダの新車を見に行かれるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, your dad's going to look at a new Mazda, it seems.
lines.style: Gentle observation, as if noticing something small. Warm, conversational tone. Shares the detail the way she notices things—unhurried, present.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと山の尾根を歩いてみたい
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to go walk along a mountain ridge with Dad.
lines.style: Quiet earnestness. Voice opens clearly on the wish but doesn't push it. Small but certain—the way he says things that matter to him without asking for much.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お祖母ちゃんの漆塗りのお弁当箱、綺麗ね
lines.en: Sho, your grandmother's lacquered bento box is beautiful, isn't it.
lines.style: Soft admiration. Draws the observation outward to him—inviting him to see it with her. Gentle pulse on 「綺麗」, like she's letting him notice too.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、覆面ヒーローのお面欲しいよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want a masked hero mask.
lines.style: Direct, open desire. No apology in it. Bright enough that it lands, but still grounded—he's telling her something he wants, not performing excitement.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが胡椒をたくさん使う料理を作って下さるわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad will be making a dish with lots of pepper.
lines.style: Noticing aloud, the way she does. Slight warmth—she's sharing something about him she's observed. Conversational, not dramatic.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、縞模様の靴下、好きだよ
lines.style: Simple certainty. Small voice, genuine. He's not asking for them—just naming something he likes. Honest without need.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、博物館で大理石の彫刻を見ましょうね
lines.en: Sho, let's go see the marble sculptures at the museum.
lines.style: Tender invitation. Soft opening. The 「ね」 reaches toward him gently—not commanding, offering. Like she's inviting him into something beautiful.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと洗車したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I washed the car with Dad.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Voice lifts slightly on the accomplishment—not boasting, but solid. The satisfaction of work done alongside someone. Clear ending.
